findings.issue: EN 'Public hub publications are readable by anyone.' is rendered عوامی ہب پر شائع ہونے والی چیزیں ('the things published on the public hub'). The referent is exactly the hub listings the locale already names اندراج — the same noun this file's own action.open_listing / action.update_listing / published.* values use, and the one ui.agents.publication uses for 'listing' in 11 ur values. The generic چیزیں is clear, but the settled noun would read as the same surface the dialog is about.
findings.evidence: 11 ur values render an EN 'listing' with اندراج (ui.agents.publication.action.publish_as_new, action.update_listing, agent_not_found.headline, name_taken.owned_body, not_owner.body, not_owner.headline + this file's action.open_listing, action.update_listing, receipt.title_updated, title.republished, title.update_listing); grep over EN values containing 'listing' in i18n/audits/evidence/ur/ui.agents.upload/ur-upload-74af897140ba/archive.log
findings.fix: عوامی ہب پر شائع شدہ اندراجات کوئی بھی پڑھ سکتا ہے۔ تنظیم کے ایجنٹس صرف اس کے ارکان پڑھ سکتے ہیں۔ (second sentence unchanged).
findings.impact: None on correctness: the shipped sentence is accurate, grammatical and natural. This is a wording preference, not a defect.

observations.topic: bidi: two data islands in one sentence are separated by the runtime, not the catalogue
observations.detail: published.org_listed places {name} and {destination} with only a quote and a space between them. Spliced raw they merge into ONE 20-byte LTR island (fribidi --rtl, level-2 run 'fleet-ops" Acme Corp'); through translate() each Latin-led argument is FSI/PDI-isolated (src/i18n/bidi.ts isolateArguments) and the level map shows two separate islands, so the RTL base orders them name-then-destination as the sentence reads. The catalogue correctly adds no controls of its own.

observations.topic: wording: not_leaving.org/.public reuse the sibling sign_in.nothing_left's 'مشین سے مخصوص ترتیب'
observations.detail: The context calls sign_in.nothing_left the past-tense sibling, so identical wording is the intended behaviour. The wider ur locale also renders 'configuration' as کنفیگریشن in 28 EN values; that split is pre-existing and out of scope for this round.

observations.topic: fit: action.publishing is four Urdu words against the sidecar's 'one word plus a single-character ellipsis' hint
observations.detail: شائع کیا جا رہا ہے… is 19 characters against شائع کریں (9) and اندراج اپ ڈیٹ کریں (18), so the footer's widest submit state changes from the update label to the progress label; the English spread is 7/11/14, so the width behaviour is comparable and no maxCells budget exists for these keys. U+2026 is used, never three periods.

observations.topic: hub naming: ہب and Agent Hub are not interchangeable in this slice, and the values follow the English
observations.detail: ہب appears exactly where the English says 'the hub' / 'public hub' (receipt.title_hub, availability.reserved_*, target.visibility_hint_public); Agent Hub appears exactly where the English says 'Agent Hub' (intro.public, title.publish_public, title.published_public, title.republished, title.update_listing). Both agree with ui.hub.pages.header.title = 'Agent Hub' and with the pre-existing sign_in.needed/published.listed in the same file.
